claims.text: Infant with a likely pathologic murmur: refer to pediatric cardiology first, rather than ordering an echocardiogram.
claims.quote: When history or examination findings suggest a pathologic murmur in an infant, consultation with pediatric cardiology is indicated as a first step instead of echocardiography or other testing.

claims.text: Routine ECG or chest X-ray is not cost-effective in a child without symptoms or signs of heart disease.
claims.quote: Routine use of electrocardiography or chest radiography in the evaluation of heart murmurs in children without symptoms or signs of heart disease is not cost-effective, even when a pathologic murmur is suspected.

claims.text: Neonate with a murmur, cyanosis, abnormal pulses or heart failure: echocardiography to confirm congenital heart disease.
claims.quote: When present, heart murmurs, cyanosis, abnormal pulses, or manifestations of heart failure suggest congenital heart disease. In neonates with these findings, echocardiography is done to confirm the diagnosis of congenital heart disease.

claims.text: Cyanosis alone: also rule out methemoglobinemia.
claims.quote: If the only abnormality is cyanosis, methemoglobinemia also should be ruled out.

claims.text: Newborn pulse oximetry screening for critical congenital heart disease before discharge, at ≥ 24 hours of age.
claims.quote: Thus, universal screening for critical congenital heart disease using pulse oximetry is recommended for all neonates before hospital discharge (1). The screening is done when infants are ≥ 24 hours old
claims.locator: Newborn Screening for Congenital Heart Disease

claims.text: Positive screen: chest X-ray, ECG, echocardiography and often blood tests.
claims.quote: All neonates with a positive screening result should undergo a comprehensive evaluation for congenital heart disease and other causes of hypoxemia (eg, various respiratory disorders, central nervous system depression, sepsis) typically including a chest x-ray, ECG, echocardiography, and often blood testing.
claims.locator: Newborn Screening for Congenital Heart Disease
